> External code submissions require prior written agreement with Eric Wang.
> See `CONTRIBUTING.md` before opening a pull request.

## Issue

Link the concrete bug, decision, or improvement this change addresses.

## What Changed

Describe the user-visible or policy behavior changed.

## Verification

List the exact tests, builds, audits, and browser checks run.

## Data And Security

- [ ] Fixtures and docs contain only synthetic or publishable data.
- [ ] No credentials, local settings, logs, backups, or private evidence are included.
- [ ] `scripts/repository_policy_check.py` passes.

## Follow-up

Link any genuinely unresolved action to an Issue. Write `None` when the change
does not create follow-up work.
